item.title: Southall Community Alliance launches free art classes for adults
item.description: In September 2026 Southall Community Alliance launched free weekly art classes for adults, as part of a project funded by the People’s Health Trust. The classes are taking place on […]
item.content:encoded: The classes are taking place on Tuesdays in Southall Town Hall from 4pm to 5.30pm.
